system.description:
You focus your chakra throughout your body, culminating in a golden buddha forming around you and making multiple strikes with its 100 arms. As an Action, on each of your turns, you can make a melee ninjutsu Attack against a creature no more than 10 feet away from you that you can seem dealing 4d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase the damage of this jutsu by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of attacks you can make with this jutsu by +1. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, you gain a special reaction called Fists of Peace, which you can take when you take damage, reducing the damage taken by 5d8. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the damage this jutsu deals and the damage reduction of Fists of Peace by 1d8.
